app.name: NorDa
app.tagline: Light meets Rose — a studio, a store, a service.

hero.body: NorDa is where ideas meet design and technology. We shape digital identities and experiences, showcase thoughtful work, and offer products that help you move forward.

art.alt: A geometric flower mark inspired by NorDa's identity
art.title: Light meets Rose

intro.title: Three paths. One connected experience.
intro.body: Whether you are starting something new or refining an existing presence, NorDa brings creative thinking and practical execution together — from the first sketch to the final detail.

web.title: Digital experiences
web.body: Websites and digital pages shaped around your goals — clear, fast, and easy to use.

identity.title: Identity & design
identity.body: Cohesive visual systems, from the mark and palette to interface and content details.

digital.title: Digital solutions
digital.body: Curated digital tools and products that save time and make work flow better.

work.title: Design is more than appearance.
work.body: Every detail should serve an idea and an experience. This is a space for selected projects and the thinking behind them.
work.disclaimer: These are illustrative preview compositions, not client projects or completed case studies.

store.title: Digital tools that move you forward.
store.body: Explore digital products, subscriptions, and carefully selected tools. Clear details, considered purchase options, and transparent availability before you decide.

contact.title: Let's turn your idea into something real.

process.title: From the first thought to the details that shape the experience.
process.body: Good work comes from clear understanding, considered decisions, and execution that respects the details.

discover.title: Understand the whole picture
discover.body: We start by listening to your needs, the people you want to reach, and the outcome you have in mind.

shape.title: Give the idea a direction
shape.body: We turn early thoughts into a clear structure, visual language, and coherent experience before building.

make.title: Build, refine, and care
make.body: We bring the experience to life, review the details, and improve it to feel useful and effortless.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link you requested isn't available. Return to the home page or browse the store.

status.demoNotice: This is a demo preview. No real transaction is performed.
status.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

services.ctaBody: Tell us what you want to create and we can define a useful first step.

store.title: Digital products, chosen with intention.
store.body: A considered collection of subscriptions, creative resources, and useful tools. Every listing will show its real price, availability, and delivery terms before you buy.
store.manifestoTitle: Useful things. Clear choices. No surprises.
store.manifestoBody: We are building a catalogue around products that solve a real need. We will publish an item only after its source, current price, availability, and delivery method have been checked.
store.familiesBody: These are collection themes, not live product listings. Individual products will appear only when their details are verified.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.body: Digital memberships and services with clear durations and renewal details.

creative.title: Creative resources
creative.body: Design assets, templates, and resources for making better work.

productivity.title: Tools for work
productivity.body: Practical software and digital utilities that make everyday work easier.

store.purchaseTitle: Know the terms before you decide.
store.purchaseBody: When products are published, each page will show the exact price, what is included, delivery timing, and any important limitations.
store.paypal: International checkout in USD. The amount is shown for the selected product before confirmation.
store.baridimob: Local payment in DZD. The DZD amount and applicable conversion basis will be displayed clearly on each product.
store.safetyNote: No payment is accepted on this preview. Checkout will be enabled only after the independent order and delivery systems are ready.

contact.noteTitle: Our contact channel is being prepared.
contact.noteFoot: We will not ask you to submit information through a form that is not connected.

clarity.title: Clarity before decoration
clarity.body: Every visual and functional decision should serve a clear purpose.

care.title: Care in the details
care.body: We consider language, spacing, motion, and usability — not appearance alone.

craft.title: Thoughtful craft
craft.body: We prefer coherent, extensible experiences over quick, disposable fixes.
